title: Foggy night encounter with a scout craft piloted by a young lady

tellings.quote: on one cold and snowy night in the fall back in the 60s when I damn near died in the fog and the scout craft with the l young lady in it and some of her friends accompanied by the deep spacecraft and the teenage craft.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he lived among tall white aliens in Nevada, says that on a cold, snowy fall night in the 1960s in Indian Springs Valley he nearly died in the fog. He says a small scout craft flown by a young lady and some of her friends came to him, joined by a large deep-space craft and what he calls a teenage craft. Hall tells it as his own experience, credits a work called The Valley of the Grays, and if it is true the beings he knew were looking out for him.
